text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp starts today—a time for
students to
come together and hone
their running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is all fired up for the
Shuka Sho,
and I'm hoping she can
further improve her skills
at camp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling we're going to be doing
a lot of
sweating this summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I heard the temperatures are
going to be
even higher than last year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well, there's that, but... that's not
what I
meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There you go again, Bright... Well, let's
make this
a good summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's! We'll have to go for a swim,
grab food
from the beachside stalls,
have pillow fights,
watch fireworks, go
to the festival...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you know I was talking about
training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm here to prepare for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And I for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dober and Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this!
We can do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp with Mejiro Dober is off to
a
sweltering start!
